user_query: I'm preparing a presentation on effective communication skills and I need some TED talks to reference. Can you recommend some speakers and fetch their details using the TED Talks API? Additionally, fetch some articles from Pluralsight.com to provide further insights on communication techniques.

TaskList.description: Fetch a list of recommended TED talks on effective communication skills.
Retrieve speaker details for the TED talks fetched in the previous step.
Search and retrieve articles related to communication techniques from Pluralsight.com.
Consolidate the information from the TED talks and Pluralsight articles into a cohesive format for the presentation.
